senses.gloss:
द्यु

DYU(dyau) . One of the Aṣṭa Vasus (eight Vasus). This vasu has another name āpa. (For details see under aṣṭavasus).

द्युमान्

DYUMĀN . A King of the dynasty of bhārgava. (bhāgavata, skandha 9).

द्युमत्सेन १

DYUMATSENA I . A King. He was the father of satyavān. He ruled over the sālva country. śaibyā was his wife. By and by he lost his eye-sight. Then another King conquered his country. dyumatsena who lost everything went to the forest with his wife śaibyā and child, satyavān. (For particulars of how satyavān married sāvitrī and how dyumatsena regained his lost kingdom, see under satyavān).

द्युमत्सेन २

DYUMATSENA II . A King who fought with śrī kṛṣṇa. (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 38). He used to attend the council of yudhiṣṭhira. (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 4).

द्यूतपर्व

DYŪTAPARVA . A subsection of Sabhā Parva, (Chapters 46 to 73), in the mahābhārata.

द्युति

DYUTI . A goddess who protected arjuna. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 37, Stanza 38)

द्युतिमान् १

DYUTIMĀN I . A King of the madra country. vijayā the daughter of this King was the wife of sahadeva, one of the pāṇḍavas. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 95, Stanza 80).

द्युतिमान् २

DYUTIMĀN II . A King of the sālva country. He gave his country to ṛcīka and attained heaven. (M.B, śānti Parva, Chapter 234, Stanza 33).

द्युतिमान्

DYUTIMĀN . III. Son of the King madirāśva born in the ikṣvāku dynasty. He was a mighty and bright hero. The King suvīra was the son of dyutimān. (M.B. anuśāsana parva, Chapter 2, Stanza 9).

द्युतिमान् ४

DYUTIMĀN IV . A hermit of the family of bhṛgu. A daughter named lakṣmī and sons named dhātā and vidhātā were born to bhṛgu by his wife khyāti. dhātā and vidhātā married the daughters of Meru named āyati and niyati. prāṇa and mṛkaṇḍu were born to the couple. mārkaṇḍeya was born from mṛkaṇḍu and vedaśiras from mārkaṇḍeya. A son named dyutimān was born to prāṇa and Rājapāla was born to dyutimān. The family of bhṛgu owes its expansion to Rājapāla. (viṣṇu purāṇa, aṁśa 1, Chapter 10).
